key_insight: AAbAAC is a small, manually annotated PubMed corpus designed to help AI systems extract autoimmunity entities and relationships more accurately.
clinical_relevance: Better information extraction in autoimmunity could support literature review, biomarker discovery, and knowledge organization for researchers working on autoimmune diseases.
method: Built an annotated corpus of 115 PubMed abstracts focused on autoimmunity.
Labeled key entities including autoimmune diseases, autoantibodies, molecular targets, body locations, and clinical signs.
Used the corpus to evaluate named entity recognition methods and fine-tune NER models.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved NER performance after fine-tuning on AAbAAC, supporting the value of domain-specific annotation.
watch_item: Because the corpus is small and limited to abstracts, results may not generalize well to full-text articles or broader biomedical settings.
paper_title: AAbAAC: An Annotated Corpus for Autoimmunity Information Extraction
